data.notes: September 2026 is anchored by experimental/electronic festival Extreme Chill, the Vaka folk gathering, and several large Icelandic pop/hip-hop anniversary shows.

events.title: Quarashi
events.summary: Quarashi celebrate their 30th anniversary with a major Laugardalshöll concert, promising their best-known songs and special guests from the band’s career.

events.title: Extreme Chill Festival 2026
events.summary: Extreme Chill returns to Reykjavík for its 17th year, focusing on experimental, electronic and ambient music across four days in the city center.

events.title: Aron Can - 10 ár á einu kvöldi
events.summary: Icelandic rapper Aron Can marks 10 years since his first album Þekkir Stráginn with one major anniversary concert at Laugardalshöll.

events.title: Joep Beving - Liminal Tour
events.summary: Dutch pianist and composer Joep Beving brings his Liminal Tour to Fríkirkjan í Reykjavík, with Sóley Stefánsdóttir listed as special guest.

events.title: Magnús Jóhann 30 ára - Stórtónleikar í Háskólabíó
events.summary: Pianist and composer Magnús Jóhann Ragnarsson celebrates his 30th birthday and 10 years since his debut solo album with a large Háskólabíó concert featuring collaborators including GDRN and jazz guests.

events.title: Vaka Folk Festival 2026
events.summary: Vaka Traditional Folk Arts Association confirms its annual flagship Vaka Folk Festival will be held in Reykjavík from September 14–20, 2026.

events.title: Mania: The ABBA Tribute
events.summary: The touring ABBA tribute show Mania plays Eldborg at Harpa, presenting a full-band recreation of ABBA’s hits.

events.title: Shrek Rave Is Coming To Reykjavik!
events.summary: Touring novelty rave brand landing at Gamla Bío with DJs playing techno, house, EDM, drum & bass and Shrek remixes, plus stage performers, visuals and themed games.

events.title: Sycamore Tree / 10 ára afmælistónleikar
events.venueName: Harpa Concert Hall and Conference Centre
events.summary: Icelandic duo Sycamore Tree mark their 10th anniversary with a Harpa concert listed for 20:00 on September 4, 2026.

events.title: RVKBear 2026 Weekend
events.venueName: Various Reykjavík venues, including Kiki Queer Bar, Bar 22 and Petersen Svítan
events.summary: Queer bear-scene weekend with official parties and events including the Thursday Welcome Party, Friday Top-off Party, Saturday Mr. Bear Contest & Party, plus VIP access and happy hour at Kiki Queer Bar and Bar 22.

events.title: Shrek Rave Is Coming To Reykjavík
events.summary: The touring Shrek Rave party comes to Gamla bíó with DJs playing dance music, party tracks and Shrek-themed remixes from 20:00 to 01:00.
